title: AFOSI confiscates footage and swears missile men to secrecy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of AFOSI confiscates footage and swears missile men to secrecy, about 1960s onward at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Time and time again, these missile men would see UFOs near nuclear facilities, and without fail, the Air Force Office of Special Investigations would show up.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, citing a former Air Force officer named Bob Jacobs, says that from the 1960s on, the men who guarded and ran US nuclear missiles kept seeing UFOs near nuclear sites. He says that every time, the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own detective service, showed up to take any film and swear the men to secrecy. If true, it would mean the military knew about the sightings and worked to hide them.
